outcome.summary: The agreement can be ended by either party through the following methods:
findings:
The agreement can be ended by either party through the following methods:

### Non-Renewal at the end of the term
To prevent the agreement from automatically renewing, a party must provide written notice of non-renewal at least 90 days before the current term ends.

> "The agreement then renews for successive 12 month terms unless either party gives at least 90 days written notice of non-renewal before the end of the current term." (Source: [1])

### Termination for Material Breach
Either party may terminate the agreement immediately via written notice if the other party commits a material breach that is not resolved within a specific timeframe.

> "Either party may terminate this agreement immediately by written notice if the other party commits a material breach and fails to remedy it within 21 days of receiving notice of the breach." (Source: [1])

The Data Processing Addendum describes obligations that occur once the services end, such as the deletion or return of personal data, but it does not provide additional rights or procedures for ending the agreement itself. (Source: [2])
